work.name: Dynatrace
highlights: Contributing to Dynatrace's effort to make profiling a first-class observability signal, including support for ingesting, processing, and producing OpenTelemetry profiling data
Building IDE integration that surfaces runtime context, profiling data, and service-level observability signals while developers work in code
Shipped AI skills, prompt workflows, and MCP integration that turn Dynatrace data into actionable answers inside developer tooling

work.name: tde
highlights: Designed and delivered a major extension to the rig state detection algorithm behind tde pronova, the company's core operation-recognition product, improving how raw rig sensor data is translated into operational states and drilling performance KPIs

Delivered major improvements to tde trace, the real-time visualization UI for rig sensor data, operation states, and performance KPIs, helping engineers investigate drilling activity and validate automated state detection
Owned architecture for full-stack drilling analytics tools used by 10 internal engineers, 10 major clients, and up to 200 rigs, spanning React frontends, Kotlin/Spring APIs, and .NET services
Led document ingestion and reporting workflows for roughly 200 daily rig reports plus monthly reports, processing client data through API and email intake instead of repetitive manual entry
Designed and implemented the Keycloak access-control model for client organizations, defining roles, groups, and permission policies that became the reference pattern for fine-grained product access
Built the company's first Amazon Bedrock assistant, taking an LLM-powered chat feature from prototype to production so users could query operational data and generate documentation
Extensively reviewed PRs, onboarded engineers, mentored junior developers, and acted as the go-to owner for core analytics and visualization subsystems

work.name: tde
highlights: Built Power BI dashboards and analytical models for drilling KPIs, operational states, and rig performance metrics used by engineering and client-facing teams
Worked directly with field engineers and clients to translate drilling operations data into actionable performance insights, building the domain expertise later applied to tde pronova and tde trace
Automated recurring analysis and reporting workflows with SQL, Python, VBA, and Excel, reducing manual spreadsheet work and improving consistency of client deliverables
